summary: Add opt-in globalComponents and the globalComponentVersion capability for session-independent UI in the host React tree, with stable activation lifetimes and existing module failure/revocation ownership.

Expose canonical respondAsk and session/chat host calls with askResponseVersion and chatReadVersion capability checks, preserving native decision identity, passive reads, cursor expiry and bounded paging.
Add the settingsVersion capability and settings component middleware for module-owned sections in the host Settings dialog, preserving host controls, dialog ownership and module business boundaries.

Move backend and frontend contracts from the root to dedicated entry points. Generate wire types from the canonical protocol, including all preparation statuses. Make environment peers optional and verify isolated TypeScript 5.9.3 / React 18 and 19 consumption.
Allocate a new release identity after the unsuccessful initial publication and correct local tarball publication.
Introduce the standalone ESM and declaration SDK. This source change record does not establish registry publication.
